messages.author: bfa43814f6ba1969
messages.subject: Re: What id Wrong with this model
parts:
Hi,

Note that lavaan is case sensitive. Thus wlb and WLB are two different variables. Is this what you intended?

Running inspect(fit) can be helpful in detecting model non-identification.

Mikko
